117538.name: Chabad of Alabama
117538.note: A Chabad.org article: Rabbi Yosef Posner 'settled here with wife Frumie in 1987' (the Friedmans joined in 1993). But in the Huntsville Times (Sept 2010) Rabbi Posner recalled 'my beginning here in Birmingham (in the early '80s)' — perhaps visits before he settled. Checked (Nov 7): Southern Jewish Life, July 10 2026 ('Chabad of Alabama establishes a foundation', https://southernjewishlife.substack.com/p/chabad-of-alabama-establishes-a-foundation): 'Chabad in Birmingham was established in 1982, the Posners arrived in 1987.' That fits Rabbi Posner's 'my beginning here in Birmingham (in the early '80s)'; so the year is Chabad's start in Birmingham, 1982 (was 1987, the Posners' settling). Medium: who began it in 1982 isn't said.

2541793.name: Chabad of Mobile
2541793.note: Chabad.org (2016, at the opening of the Olender Chabad House): 'it was only two years ago' that Mobile was added to Chabad's map; Anash (2025): 'in just 11 years' the Goldwassers; therebbesimpact.com: 2014. They came from Crown Heights after a first visit at Chanukah (SJL, 'Mobile gaining new Chabad presence'). Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 288 Mayflower Street, Mobile (Aug 2014, Feb 2017); then 812 Downtowner Boulevard, Suite F, Mobile (Dec 2019); it is now at 451 Azalea Road, Mobile, so it moved there after Dec 2019 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 288 Mayflower Street, Mobile (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Aug 26 2014 to Feb 26 2017)
812 Downtowner Boulevard, Suite F, Mobile (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Dec 7 2019)

2948851.name: Chabad at the University of Alabama
2948851.note: Chabad.org: 'Rabbi Kussi and Rosie Lipskier have been serving at the University of Alabama since 2015'; The Odyssey: 'in 2015 ... moved to Tuscaloosa to open the Chabad Jewish Center' (one of 19 campus centers opening that fall). Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 233 Cedar Crest, Tuscaloosa (Mar 2017); it is now at 17 Sherwood Drive, Tuscaloosa, listed there by Dec 2019, so it moved there between Mar 2017 and Dec 2019.

earlier.where: 233 Cedar Crest, Tuscaloosa (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Mar 3 2017)

7055697.name: Chabad on Wheels
7055697.note: CrownHeights.info, 18 June 2025: Rabbi Sholom Posner's Chabad on Wheels, crossing Alabama several times a year; no start date given. chabad.org's listing number (7055697) is from 2025. A mobile program of Chabad of Alabama. Its chabad.org listing went up on Oct 28 2025 (chabad.org's own record), so it existed by then.

1015137.name: Chabad of Huntsville
1015137.note: Huntsville Times (CrownHeights.info, 12 Sept 2010): 'Rabbi Laibel Berkowitz with his wife, Chanie, and 6-month-old daughter, Muka, have moved to the Huntsville area to establish the Chabad Jewish Center of North Alabama' (the listing number, 1015137, is from about then). Rabbi Moshe and Mushky Cohen founded today's Chabad of Huntsville in 2015 (SJL, 2023).

7392590.name: Chabad of Auburn
7392590.note: Anash, 8 July 2026: Rabbi Aryeh and Chana Wells 'will move to Auburn this fall' for Auburn University, building on Rabbi Shalom Posner's Chabad on Wheels. (Read through Firecrawl.)
